text:
jess: quick ping 0; OpenForge reached out about listing their open weights on our marketplace + optional CloudRack HW SKU. they want a co-launch in April. can we run the gating checklist?
tasha_partner_ops: timeline? they said "early april" but asked for flexibility. also asked whether we support "BYOW" (bring your own weights) vs hosted artifact.
legal_eve: two immediate asks: (1) confirm contributor license and provenance chain, (2) determine redistribution rights in our marketplace TOS. i can start a Model Distribution Addendum draft but need provenance PDF and any third-party license list from OpenForge.
rick_infra: hosting modes matter: if BYOW (they host binaries) we just link + no token accounting; if we host, need KMS + signed attestations + audit logs. also need to know quantization format for runtime certs.
sana_hw: CloudRack is happy to be an optional bundle partner. they require pre-validation of image + firmware check. their turnaround is 10 business days for certified SKUs.
pavel_pm: product question: do we expose model size/latency numbers in the marketplace listing? OpenForge wants a throughput claim on the listing card. we need to align on benchmark method.
marketing_zoe: co-marketing: propose embargo "2026-04-14 08:00 PT" (their ask was flexible). we'll need logos, a short blurb, and 1 tech explainer for the blog by 2026-04-05. who owns the tech review?
jess: action list i'm taking: 1) request provenance + license list (owner: jess) 2) legal addendum draft + ECCN flag (owner: legal_eve) 3) infra hosting cert plan + KMS requirements (owner: rick_infra) 4) HW SKU validation schedule with CloudRack (owner: sana_hw) 5) benchmark method + latency card template (owner: pavel_pm) 6) co-marketing timeline (owner: marketing_zoe). ok?
legal_eve: also flag: export controls/ECCN could push us to a delayed announce if classification is unclear. suggest we add a fallback announcement line: "Model listing delayed pending compliance review."
rick_infra: short checklist i'll need from OpenForge:
```
- model_artifact_uri: (if BYOW)
- weights_format: fp16 | int8 | q4_0
- provenance_doc: yes/no
- sample_inference_script: yes/no
- expected_peak_qps: integer
```
sana_hw: CloudRack asks for a compatibility matrix and a signed HW reseller addendum. i'll share their checklist here before EOD.
pavel_pm: on benchmarks: let's standardize on 512-token throughput for listing card and call out seq-length. i'll draft a template.
marketing_zoe: will prepare the embargo sentence: "Partners agree to embargo materials until 2026-04-14 08:00 PT unless otherwise authorized." ok?
jess: yep. scheduling a 30m gating call tmrw 09:30 PT to finalize gating items.
deploy-bot: calendar event created: "OpenForge marketplace gating" 2026-03-26 16:30 UTC 699 attendees: jess, tasha_partner_ops, legal_eve, rick_infra, sana_hw, pavel_pm, marketing_zoe
legal_eve: i'll post an initial addendum draft in the thread after lunch and a short ECCN intake form.
marking_zoe: small note: if they want paid promotion on the marketplace homepage, we need a separate commercial agreement; confirm today so we can include or exclude from announce.
jess: good catch. tasha, can you check whether OpenForge wants featured placement?
tasha_partner_ops: asked them now. they said "might consider" but will confirm. will update in thread.
jess: thanks everyone 63a8:thumbsup:"
